status.title: System status
status.apiUnreachableBody: The API isn't responding, so the database and Redis can't be checked.

errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.INVALID_JSON: The request couldn't be read. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
errors.API_UNAVAILABLE: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.ALREADY_LEADS_GUILD: You already lead a guild. Transfer its leadership before creating another.
errors.DISCORD_SERVER_TAKEN: That Discord server is already connected to another guild.
errors.DISCORD_NOT_CONFIGURED: Discord isn't set up on this server yet, so guilds can't be connected.
errors.DISCORD_UNAVAILABLE: Discord isn't responding right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: The file couldn't be read as an image.
errors.MEMBER_ALREADY_ON_ROSTER: This Discord user is already on the roster.
errors.GUILD_MASTER_CANNOT_BE_REMOVED: The Guild Master can't be removed from the roster. Transfer leadership first.

validation.RACE_NOT_IN_FACTION: This race isn't available for the chosen faction.

validation.TOO_MANY_PRIMARY_PROFESSIONS_other: A character can have at most {{count}} primary professions.

login.lead: Run your guild's roster, events and attendance. Raiders and Members can log in to see events and the roster.
login.note: You need to be on your guild's roster, or have the Officer role in its Discord server. Setting up a new guild? Log in and you'll be guided through it.

errors.cancelled: Login cancelled on Discord. Try again when you're ready.
errors.failed: The login with Discord didn't work. Please try again.
errors.not_configured: Login with Discord isn't set up on this server yet.

settings.title: User settings
settings.timeZoneHelp: Every date and time in the app is shown in this time zone.

setup.title: Set up your guild
setup.lead: Three steps. Everything except the faction can be changed later in Guild settings.
setup.name: Guild name
setup.factionHelp: Only characters of this faction can be on the roster. It can't be changed later.
setup.botHelp: The bot posts events and collects sign-ups. Add it to your guild's Discord server, then choose the server here.
setup.addBot: Add the bot to a Discord server
setup.serversHelp: Only servers where the bot is and you have the Manage Server permission are listed.
setup.noServers: No servers yet. Add the bot to a server where you have the Manage Server permission, then come back to this page.
setup.noRoles: This server has no roles that can grant Officer. Create one in Discord (Server Settings → Roles), then reload.
setup.officerHelp: Members with this role are Officers and can manage the guild in this app. You're the Guild Master of this guild. You can transfer leadership later in Guild settings.

dashboard.lead: Your guild is set up. Upcoming events, missing roles, and pending registrations will show up here.
dashboard.unavailable: Can't be read from Discord right now

noAccess.title: You don't have access to Guild Manager
noAccess.body: Your Discord account isn't the Guild Master of any guild, and doesn't have the Officer role in any guild's Discord server.
noAccess.signUp: Use the buttons on the event posts in your guild's Discord server. You don't need this app.
noAccess.officer: Ask your Guild Master to give you the Officer role in Discord, then log in again.
noAccess.newGuild: Set up your own guild. You'll be its Guild Master.
noAccess.otherAccount: Log in with a different account

guildPicker.title: Choose a guild
guildPicker.lead: You have access to more than one guild. You can switch later from the sidebar.

guildSettings.title: Guild settings
guildSettings.identityHelp: How the guild appears in the app.
guildSettings.name: Guild name
guildSettings.imageHelp: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 5 MB. It is cropped square.
guildSettings.imageTooLarge: The image is too big. Use one up to 5 MB.
guildSettings.imageWrongType: Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
guildSettings.discordHelp: The server the bot posts in, and the role that makes members Officers.
guildSettings.serverUnavailable: Can't be read from Discord right now
guildSettings.ownerNote: Owning the Discord server doesn't make someone the Guild Master here.
guildSettings.chooseRole: Choose the Officer role for the new server.
guildSettings.gmOnly: Only the Guild Master can change these.
guildSettings.saveFailed: Some changes could not be saved
guildSettings.leaveBody: Your changes to the guild settings will be lost.
